title: GPT-6 Astra: Don't Miss OpenAI's Launch Disaster
description:
OpenAI said Astra was out. Yet Astra is not in the Codex model picker, while selected accounts appear to have early access. Flag on the play. I break down the botched GPT-6 Astra rollout, the influencer economy around OpenAI launches, and why claims of AGI-level computer use should get real testing before hype.

I also get into the AI service outage rumors, the messy security problem with non-deterministic LLMs, AI data centers, and the business incentives behind the AI debate. Important: the claims I discuss about a GPT-6 Astra-driven outage, early-access terms, and Y Combinator's alleged conduct have not been independently verified. Treat them accordingly.

Later, I get into why I think the post-modal era has arrived, the story behind my PhD in VR and real-time data visualization, H-1B and offshoring claims in tech, Amazon and Meta hiring, Y Combinator, Paul Graham, a CS Career Questions moderation dispute over H-1B, tech layoffs, and what it all means for American workers.

Subscribe for AI accountability, OpenAI commentary, tech layoffs, offshoring, H-1B reporting, data-center politics, and the fights Silicon Valley would rather keep off your feed.
